##### Project general facts

Ajman Pearl Tower by GJ Properties is a contemporary residential high-rise located in Ajman Downtown, offering a refined urban living experience in one of the city’s most dynamic and well-connected areas. The architecture follows a modern vertical expression with clean lines, balanced proportions, and a functional design approach that emphasizes light, space, and efficiency. With 208 exclusive apartments, the tower integrates contemporary aesthetics with everyday practicality, while its strategic location ensures quick access to beaches, retail hubs, schools, and healthcare facilities.

The development is enhanced by a well-planned selection of amenities designed to support comfort, relaxation, and an active lifestyle. Residents can enjoy a resort-style swimming pool, fully equipped health club, landscaped green areas, and dedicated children’s play spaces. Retail outlets within the tower add everyday convenience, while secure access, covered parking, and high-speed elevators ensure a smooth and effortless living experience throughout the building.

Interiors are finished with modern, high-quality materials that reflect a clean and contemporary design language. The apartments feature well-planned layouts that maximize space and natural light, creating a comfortable and functional living environment. Kitchens are fully equipped, ensuring practical everyday use, while residences are delivered unfurnished, allowing homeowners the flexibility to personalize their interiors according to their individual style and preferences.

##### Location description and benefits

Ajman the smallest yet most diverse of all emirates in UAE. Located strategically in the middle of the emirates, it borders Sharjah and only 10 km away from Dubai. Hence, it provides an easy commute to other emirates. The perennial sunshine of its golden shores sitting alongside the serene beaches is a heaven away from the hassles of life. Its untouched landscapes, misty mangroves, Age-old traditions and authentic culture, along with the contemporary infrastructure make it a unique place to experience.

Ajman’s diversity and sustainable development attracts a large number of investors who are keen to tap into its lucrative business opportunities. The opening of Ajman’s free zone and visa extensions for investors is injecting more liquidity into the local economy and is boosting the underlying confidence of foreign investors. New laws by the UAE government to grant citizenship to expatriates and easing the rules to provide a conducive atmosphere for them, Ajman is rapidly growing as a major hub for prospective investors to live and work in.

The overall vibe of this emirate, due to the rate of new developments and years’ old traditions, is so soothing that it has an edge over other emirates to cater to anyone seeking comfort, luxury, and tranquility at the same time.
